# Vendored code

`jsQR.js` is `dist/jsQR.js` from [jsqr](https://www.npmjs.com/package/jsqr)
1.4.0, unmodified, under the Apache 2.0 license in `jsQR.LICENSE`. The app loads
it only in browsers without a `BarcodeDetector` that reads QR codes.
